representativeSnapshot.kind: Supabase project with Phase 1 through Phase 3 promoter migrations applied

rowCountQueries: approved promoter memberships and open promotion programs by event
active native promo codes by event
effective RLS grants for the new binding tables and all four asset functions
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Creates two additive binding tables and four service-role-only commands. No existing ticketing, post, share, attribution, or financial rows are rewritten.

execution.resumeStrategy: All DDL is additive/idempotent. Asset commands lock only the referenced membership row; the tracking resolver deduplicates same-session repeat touches for 30 seconds.
execution.idempotency: Promo-code and social-source unique constraints prevent a code or native source from being claimed by multiple promoters; opaque tracking tokens use a unique SHA-256 hash.

quarantine.strategy: No historical rows are backfilled. New bindings are created only after server-side membership, program, event, and native source checks.

constraints: A promo code can be actively bound to only one membership and must belong to the promoter program event
Social source ownership is immutable at the source-type/source-id boundary
Client roles have read-only access to their own bindings and cannot execute asset commands
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Create a link as an approved promoter, resolve it twice with the same attribution session, bind one existing event promo code, create an event post and a share, then verify another user cannot claim the same code or source.

recovery.rollback: Disable event_promoter_attribution_capture_enabled. Existing tracking links and attribution evidence remain preserved for audit and later forward repair.
recovery.forwardFix: Use an additive migration for any function, RLS, or binding correction; do not delete captured attribution evidence.

queries: function execute grants include service_role and exclude anon/authenticated
new table RLS policies and grants expose only membership-owner reads
the resolver returns no row for revoked, expired, suspended, or closed-program links
same promo code and social source cannot be assigned to two memberships
